rows.expectedResultText: The powder freely dispersed in water

tests.procedure: Under strong white light check each received sample container separately in a clean transparent watch glass or glass dish for foreign particles, colour and conformity with the visual specification.
tests.source: Opadry White__STM Opadry White new without micro.txt:28

tests.procedure: Disperse 1 g of sample into 20 mL of water; the powder should diffuse into water and form a uniform matrix.

details.reference: Analytical Method Verification Report For Dispersion in Opadry White

tests.source: Opadry White__STM Opadry White new without micro.txt:29

tests.procedure: Make a slurry of the powder in an equal-volume mixture of isopropyl alcohol and dichloromethane, pour it onto a glass tile and dry; a film must form.

details.reference: Analytical Method Verification Report For Identification in Opadry White

tests.source: Opadry White__STM Opadry White new without micro.txt:30

tests.procedure: Ash content: weigh an empty crucible previously ignited at 800 °C (W1); weigh about 1.0 g sample into it (W2); ignite in a muffle furnace at 800 ± 50 °C for 2 h; cool in desiccator; weigh the crucible with residue (W4); W3 = W4 - W1; total ash = W2 - W3; % total ash = total ash / W2 x 100.

details.formula: % total ash = (W2 - W3) / W2 x 100, W3 = W4 - W1 (as written)
details.reference: Analytical Method Verification Report For Ash Content in Opadry White
